en: Proverbs 19

p.src: 1  Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

ja: しい者は、 よこしまなことを語る
en: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
u.src: 1  Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

p.src: 2  It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

en: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.
u.src: 2  It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

p.src: 3  The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

en: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.
u.src: 3  The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

p.src: 4  Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

en: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
u.src: 4  Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

p.src: 5  A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

en: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
u.src: 5  A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

p.src: 6  Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

en: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
u.src: 6  Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

p.src: 7  All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

ja: しい者は親族すべてから避けられる。 まして
en: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
u.src: 7  All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

p.src: 8  He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

en: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
u.src: 8  He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

p.src: 9  A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

ja: れない。 偽りを語る
en: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
u.src: 9  A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

p.src: 10  Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

ja: にぜいたくな暮らしはふさわしくない。 まして、しもべが
することはふさわしくない。
en: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
u.src: 10  Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

p.src: 11  The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

en: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
u.src: 11  The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

p.src: 12  The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

ja: のようだが、 その好意は
en: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
u.src: 12  The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

p.src: 13  A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
u.src: 13  A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

p.src: 14  House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

ja: ぐものだが、 慎重な
en: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
u.src: 14  House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

p.src: 15  Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

ja: りに陥れ、 働かない
en: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
u.src: 15  Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

p.src: 16  He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

en: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
u.src: 16  He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

p.src: 17  He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

en: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.
u.src: 17  He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

p.src: 18  Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

ja: に手を貸してはならない。
en: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
u.src: 18  Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

p.src: 19  A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

ja: けなければならない。 彼を救っても、また救わねばならない。
en: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
u.src: 19  A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

p.src: 20  Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

ja: け入れよ。 そうすれば、
en: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
u.src: 20  Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

p.src: 21  There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

ja: の助言こそが実現する。
en: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
u.src: 21  There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

p.src: 22  That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

ja: しみが人を慕わしい者とする。 偽りを語る者より、
en: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
u.src: 22  That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

p.src: 23  The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

en: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
u.src: 23  The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

p.src: 24  The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

ja: れても、 それを再び
に運ぼうとさえしない。
en: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
u.src: 24  The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

p.src: 25  Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

en: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
u.src: 25  Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

p.src: 26  He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

ja: と不名誉をもたらす息
en: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
u.src: 26  He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

p.src: 27  If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

ja: よ、教訓に耳を傾けるのをやめれば、
en: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
u.src: 27  If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

p.src: 28  A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

en: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
u.src: 28  A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

p.src: 29  Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

en: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
u.src: 29  Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
